description: Bring your Jobber business context into ChatGPT. Get answers and take action across your clients, quotes, jobs, invoices, and schedule. Use it to see what needs your attention, check who owes you money, plan upcoming work, or turn a customer email into a ready-to-review quote. Review and approve changes before they’re made.
